sources.title: SDI-12-LB/LS documentation, 2.6.4 Example 4 Connect to TEROS-12
sources.edition: web page accessed 2026-10-04 (screenshots dated 2023-06 in file names)

claims.derived_rule: aD0! has 3 values for TEROS 12, 2 for TEROS 11 (EC TEROS 12 only)
claims.limitation: no sample string, ttt and n values not printed

claims.derived_rule: a=3 ttt=001 n=3 for TEROS 12 fw 1.12 on Dragino bench
claims.limitation: single screenshot, one sensor, firmware 1.12 only

claims.derived_rule: aI! reply = addr + '13' + 'METER   ' + 'TER11 '|'TER12 ' + 3-digit version/100 + serial <=13 chars

test.expected: addr 1, sdi 1.3, model TER12, fw 1.14, serial 631800001

claims.limitation: firmware 3.00 guide prints version 114; serial format varies (Dragino fw 1.12 shows T12-00024895)

claims.derived_rule: version field 112 = fw 1.12; serial alphanumeric with hyphen
claims.limitation: Dragino bench, fw 1.12

claims.derived_rule: field 1 has two decimals, temp one decimal, EC integer on fw 1.12
claims.limitation: do not assume the same decimals for fw 3.00

claims.derived_rule: same
claims.limitation: bench condition unknown

claims.derived_rule: derived decode: 0DC8=3528 mV battery, 01 payver, then 34 ASCII bytes aI! reply incl CRLF, then 18 bytes aD0! reply incl CRLF (DATACUT1=34, DATACUT2=18)
claims.limitation: identification text is in payload only because COMMAND1=3I! was configured

claims.derived_rule: bench config
claims.limitation: 12VT 1000 ms; Example 5 uses 13000 ms due to other sensors

claims.quote: <calibratedCountsVWC> Calibrated ADC counts for volumetric water content
claims.derived_rule: field 1 name; no range given
claims.limitation: unit none, no range, no resolution for counts

claims.quote: RAW is the raw sensor output, when read with a METER or third-party data logger.
claims.derived_rule: RAW defined as raw sensor output; never equated with calibratedCountsVWC
claims.limitation: link between the two names is not stated

claims.quote: should read 0.332 (2650 raw) to 0.363 (2730 raw) m3/m3 on the verification clip
claims.derived_rule: verification clip RAW 2650 and 2730 map to 0.3323 and 0.3634 via Eq.6
claims.limitation: clip numbers are on printed p.2, not p.9

claims.derived_rule: mineral VWC

claims.limitation: arithmetic in calc.py

claims.derived_rule: soilless VWC
claims.limitation: validity range of RAW not stated

claims.derived_rule: apparent permittivity
claims.limitation: 3596.5 gives 135.04 > documented 80; eps=80 at RAW 3393.6

claims.derived_rule: EC temp normalisation, sensor reports EC25
claims.limitation: normalisation is applied inside the sensor per guide Table 11

claims.quote: sigma_p = eps_p sigma_b/(eps_b - eps_sigma_b=0); eps_p = 80.3-0.37(T-20); offset 4.1
claims.derived_rule: pore-water EC; do not use below VWC 0.10
claims.limitation: manual mislabels equation number in text

claims.quote: -9999 ... measurement function compromised ... -9992 ... corrupt or lost calibrations ... -9991 ... insufficient voltage
claims.derived_rule: error values replace the measured value
claims.limitation: scope (field vs whole observation) not stated; formatting not printed; absent in 1.07 guides

claims.quote: 64 thermistor broken, backup measurement; 128 firmware corrupt; 256 calibrations lost
claims.derived_rule: aV! then aD0! gives a±<meta> sum of flags
claims.limitation: other bits undefined

claims.quote: The TEROS 11/12 will omit the DDI Serial startup string (sensor identification) when the SDI-12 address is nonzero. Changing the address to a nonzero address is recommended
claims.derived_rule: nonzero address suppresses DDI string
claims.limitation: conflicts with UM p.9 and p.20

claims.quote: The sensor SDI-12 address must be returned to 0 to work with ZENTRA loggers. / Sensor only works if address is zero
claims.derived_rule: address 0 required for ZENTRA
claims.limitation: scope probably METER loggers; not stated

claims.quote: Power Up Time (SDI-12) Typical 245 ms; (SDI-12, DDI Serial disabled) 145/155/165 ms; Measurement Duration max 150 ms
claims.derived_rule: derived: after switching power, wait >=165 ms at nonzero address, more at address 0; measurement <=150 ms

test.expected: first command not before 165 ms; response after aM! wait ttt

claims.limitation: address-0 maximum not printed

claims.derived_rule: EC on the wire in uS/cm integer
claims.limitation: guide rev 02 says dS/m, rev 03-05 print mS/cm; fw 1.12 example shows integer values

claims.derived_rule: EC unit change is documentation-only (firmware column unchanged)
claims.limitation: interpretation

claims.quote: CRC6 checksum example input is <TAB>2749.0 23.8 660<CR>g8 and the resulting checksum output is O (uppercase O).
claims.derived_rule: printed code computes lowercase o; TEROS 11 example printed with 1797.2 computes V not 2 (1797.7 gives 2)
claims.limitation: affects only R3/R4/DDI, not aM!/aD0!

transcripts.notes: vendor_example, TEROS 12 fw 1.12 (from the aI! in the debug screenshot), Dragino bench. The lone reply 3 is the service request.
vendor_example as printed; the guide prints the command and reply on one line
vendor_example; TEROS 11 and TEROS 12 DDI strings; CRC char of the TEROS 12 one disagrees with the printed C code (computes o)
